title: 13 years of GTA 6 waiting, in 40 seconds #gta6 #shorts
description:
From GTA 5 in 2013 to launch day on November 19, 2026: one tourist, one very long walk, and a beard that kept growing.

Dates from Rockstar's announcements; trailer record from Guinness World Records; day-one sales from Take-Two (via AP).
